description: Semantic search over FlyTrap's crawled feature index: describe the app you want ("a budgeting app with shared expenses and recurring reminders") and get the public apps whose observed in-app features cover it, with the matched and missing requirements per app. Use for competitor and market research; use lookup_app when you already know the app name or package id.

query.description: Plain-language description of the wanted app
